DIRECT_EXECUTABLE_PROOF: Construct the smallest deterministic fixture that exercises the exact requirement and captures observable before/after canonical state.
Add one positive, one boundary, one negative, and one replay case tied directly to the requirement ID.
VERSION_MIGRATION: Create previous/current/incompatible version fixtures and explicit migration functions with pre/post semantic digests.
Test upgrade, rejection of unsupported future/incompatible state, rollback, interrupted migration, and replay after migration.
TRANSACTION_CONCURRENCY: Declare read/write sets, expected revisions, ownership/token semantics, and commit/abort behavior.
Randomize ordering/retries/stale inputs and prove one deterministic canonical result with no duplicate mutation.
REFERENCE_PRECISION: Generate deterministic transform vectors at near, shell, horizon, extreme positive/negative, and vertical coordinates.
Measure round-trip error and continuity under rebases/reference handoffs; publish numeric tolerances and maximum observed error.
FOLD_PROPERTY: Use property-based vectors for near-field identity, monotonicity, boundedness, continuity, unique inverse targeting, and canonical-topology preservation.
Inject invalid/singular/out-of-range cases and prove explicit safe failure or fallback.
LOD_TRANSITION: Define the exact conservation vector and transition payload for source/target representations.
Cycle promotion/demotion repeatedly, change update cadence, inject cancellation/failure, and compare canonical digests for drift.
IDENTITY_PERSISTENCE: Track stable IDs, ownership, references, lifecycle/tombstone state, and historical lineage through fold/save/migration cycles.
Inject stale copies, duplicate ownership attempts, retirement/destruction, and reconstruction; verify no fork/resurrection.
CAUSAL_REPLAY: Emit deterministic event IDs, causal parents, pre/post references, seeds/model versions, and semantic digests.
Replay/reconstruct from checkpoint + history, then corrupt/reorder/omit events and verify first-divergence detection.
ECOLOGY_CONSERVATION: Create a small high-fidelity reference ecology and a remote/cohort abstraction using identical seeds.
Compare population/resource conservation, migration topology, deterministic stochastic outcomes, and rehydration error.
ECONOMY_CONSERVATION: Use conservation-auditable money/inventory/population/logistics fixtures across at least two settlements.
Inject route loss, shortages, migration, worker/replay boundaries, and verify no duplicate inventory/population or impossible travel-time shortcuts.
NARRATIVE_KNOWLEDGE: Separate canonical facts, narrative priority/reservations, and observer-local knowledge/belief state.
Test competing events, stale/false information, bounded priority, off-screen deferral, and replay of the same eligibility/arbitration decision.
MATERIALIZATION_READINESS: Model dependency/readiness states explicitly and gate interaction until all authoritative dependencies required by the requirement are ready.
Inject slow/missing dependency, cancellation, worker failure, and retry; verify no duplicate embodiment or fabricated canonical state.
PRESENTATION_REGRESSION: Build deterministic reference frames/descriptors for the exact visual/audio property and bind them to world/fold/reference versions.
Measure seam/popping/jitter/artifact and frame-budget metrics over fixed traversal traces; preserve canonical digests across quality degradation.
SAVE_RECOVERY: Checkpoint at deterministic canonical barriers and record dirty partitions/ledger cut/version metadata.
Inject interruption/corruption/stale fragments, recover repeatedly, and compare canonical checkpoint digests plus recovery-time objective.
RESOURCE_STRESS: Declare explicit budgets, pressure metrics, degradation order, hysteresis/backpressure, and starvation bounds.
Increase load past budget, capture p50/p95/p99/high-water/backlog recovery, and prove authoritative state survives overload.
MULTI_WORKER_CONFORMANCE: Run the same seeded scenario under 1, 2, and 4 spawned workers or the highest practical hosted profile using deterministic commit semantics.
Randomize worker completion/order, repartition or restart one worker, and compare canonical/ledger/save digests.
TRAVERSAL_PORTAL: Create deterministic route/portal/teleport traces with canonical time, occupancy/collision, route phase, and prewarm milestones.
Test rapid direction reversal, missed prewarm, moving phenomena, portal/interior boundaries, and recovery to target fidelity.
MATHEMATICAL_VALIDATION: Declare units/domains/ownership/precision for every involved variable or operator and reject invalid mixed-domain operations.
Run golden vectors, boundary/NaN/Inf/overflow cases, sensitivity tests, and compare adapter-disabled canonical truth.
AUTONOMOUS_HISTORY: Create an exact historical cut plus long-horizon/archive/rehydration path with provenance classes.
Compare fine-step vs abstract evolution, old-save continuation, compaction/rehydration, and pre-existing history digests after expansion.
SCALE_SOAK: Define the precise duration/load/capacity profile and success thresholds before execution.
Run a sustained stress/soak with checkpoints and fault injection; measure drift, leaks, storage growth, queue stability, and recovery.
